+# BASS_CR adaptive q-bins, true-child-moment supplier (2026-10-15)
+
+실행 노드: `CR_ADAPTIVE_Q_GRID_FROM_ENVELOPE_WIDTH` (부모 `bass_cr` PR70 / commit `6898f3dd0ab5acff066fb0239339ec44c8d70398`). 이 패키지의 `src/adaptive_q.py`는 실제 현재 photon packet oracle에서 정확한 자식 `N,U_ref`를 생성하여 PR70 shape-free H/He event/heat 구간을 재계산하고, 불확실성 우선순위에 따라 q-energy cell만 세분화한다.
+
+**중요:** 현행 `rei_bianchi` C7/C8의 `N,U`만 갖는 photon stock에서는 자식 moment가 결정되지 않는다. 이 모듈은 packet/source quadrature/새로 진화시킨 진짜 subbin moment가 없으면 독립적인 refinement/admission을 하지 않는다. 본 연구의 source 및 두-age packet은 별도 오라클이며, SOURCE07의 이미 승인된 numerical variant나 old49/guard51 산출물을 바꾸지 않는다.
+
+기본 성능·과학 실험:
+
+```bash
+python3 -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt  # 필요한 경우, 가상환경
+PYTHONPATH=src pytest -q tests
+PYTHONPATH=src python3 src/adaptive_benchmark.py --base 64 --max 128 --uniform 96 128 --priority HEI
+PYTHONPATH=src python3 src/adaptive_benchmark.py --base 64 --max 128 --uniform 96 128 --priority HEI --hardened
+PYTHONPATH=src python3 src/prefix_benchmark.py
+PYTHONPATH=src python3 src/adaptive_parallel.py --rays 4
+python3 verify_package.py
+```
+
+물리 변인: reference q-energy in eV, physical `E=R Eref`, proper seconds, neutral proper cm^-3, signature (-,+,+,+), photon count per original H. Original emitted BB50k source: MD14 native48, `fesc0.2`, physical 13.6..100eV and q support13.6..433eV. Verner fit cutoffs13.60/24.59/54.42eV, physical binding13.598434599702/24.587389011/54.41776eV separate. Angular Jacobian `R J_Omega` is external owner responsibility, never introduced here.
+
+출력 인증 범위: **이미 주어진 실제 packet의 정확한 dyadic mass/first moment 및 진짜 support를 조건으로 한 국소 고정-gas 한 단계 shape-free event/heat 포함구간**. Decimal85/mpmath interval/Fraction 경로는 원본 PR70 의존 코드로 보존했다. 정확한 원 photon 법칙/Verner fit의 물리적 불확실성·전체 H/He/Tg history 오차는 미포함. `HOLD_PRECISION_TARGET`는 failure이 아니라 목표 폭 미달을 의미한다.

+# R5 + C5/C7/C8: Shape-free moment envelope에 의한 q-energy 적응형 세분화
+
+**관측 날짜:** 2026-10-15 KST. **선택 노드:** `CR_ADAPTIVE_Q_GRID_FROM_ENVELOPE_WIDTH`, 부모 `bass_cr` PR70 실제 head `6898f3dd0ab5acff066fb0239339ec44c8d70398`. 다른 개발 repo 원본 파일은 수정하지 않는다. 이번 새 코드는 독립 소스/실험 범위에 속하며 전체 `rei_bianchi` ion/electron/Tgas 역사나 Landau 전파자 문제와 혼동하지 않는다.
+
+## 정확한 수학적 가정과 결과
+
+한 q-cell `I=[a,b]`의 양의 photon 측도를 `mu`라 두고, 정확히 알려진 `N=∫dmu>0, U=∫Eref dmu`로부터 종별 H I, He I, He II 광이온화/광가열의 frozen-neutral one-step response `g_k(R Eref)`를 평가한다. 원 PR70 정리:
+
+`N conv_I(g_k(R·))(U/N) <= ∫ g_k(R E)dmu <= N conc_I(g_k(R·))(U/N)`.
+
+여기서 convex/concave envelopes는 실제 Verner photo-fit cutoff에서 좌우 값을 구별한다. 원 코드의 85자리 directed smooth-segment curvature bound와 mp.iv55·Fraction outer hull을 재사용한다.
+
+**새 refinement의 필수 전제:** 부모 bin을 자식 `I_j`로 자를 때 실제 현재 positive measure의 `N_j,U_j`가 별도로 주어져야 한다. 이 값으로 정의한 admissible 측도의 집합은 부모 admissible 측도의 부분집합이므로, 수학적 정확 실수 범위에서 `Lparent <= Σ Lchild <= true <= Σ Uchild <= Uparent`이다. 구현은 두 수치 outer bounds의 **Fraction 정확 교집합**을 누적해 전 과정에서 monotonic enclosure와 positivity를 유지한다. source에서 자식 데이터를 알 수 없는 경우 부모 `(N,U)`만으로 분해를 발명하지 않는다.
+
+`PositivePacketOracle`은 source-conditioned GL packet과 hardening 받은 둘 이상의 photon cohort라는 **추가 정보**를 실제 양의 packet 원본으로 받아, IEEE 저장 입력의 `Fraction` exact prefix `(count, energy)`를 구축한다. 자식 query는 `bisect_left` 2회와 prefix 차로 O(log P)이며 source packet 의미의 양성·모멘트 보존을 정확하게 검사한다. HEI priority는 `max_j(width_j/budget_j)`의 단순 충분 heuristic; 반복 선형 후보 스캔 대신 우선순위 heap을 사용하고 변경된 두 자식만 재평가한다. 현재 width-budget를 만족하지 못하면 `HOLD_PRECISION_TARGET`를 출력한다. 타겟 1e-10 count/H HeI는 이 제조 한 단계에 대해서만 의미를 가진다.
+
+**이해해야 할 반례:** mass1, mean25eV의 두 packet 측도 `delta_25`와 `(delta_24.5+delta_25.5)/2`는 동일 부모 `(N,U)`이지만 HeI 문턱24.59eV의 아래쪽 자식 질량은 서로 다르다. 따라서 부모 moment만으로 사후 adaptive refinement가 실제 오차를 줄였다고 주장하는 것은 부당하다. 내장 test가 이 정확 dyadic 반례를 보호한다.
+
+## 재현된 scientific input
+
+- 최초 조건: BB 50,000K 원 MD14 z20 source native48 32-Simpson 분율, q-energy 13.6..433eV, 소스 통합 emission `4.298036114764196e-8` photon/original H, current physical ratio R=1, gas nHI=`0.0017575700008892194` cm^-3, nHeI=`0.0001429214010766023` cm^-3, nHeII=0, proper `dt=1e10s`.
+- 별도 제조 hardened 2-age: old birth R=.98, new birth R=1, old packet preabsorption gas `(0.001,.00012,.00001)`, pre-dt2e9s, current R=.97, neutral `(.0008,.00009,.000005)`, current dt4e9s, each birth half source photons. This is **not owner SOURCE07 C7 z20/z4 actual two-epoch physical dataset**.
+- Positive GL8 source packet measures are fixed once before refining. Both uniform and adaptive cases operate on EXACT same saved positive binary64 packet universe. Any more accurate full continuous source result is a separate layer from these *source-sample conditioned* exact dyadic comparisons.
+
+### Measured HeI one-step shape-free interval widths
+
+| physical packet corpus | bins | adaptive HeI width [count/H] | same-cell-count uniform HeI width | ratio uniform/adaptive |
+|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
+| original z20 source | 96 | 1.67211982329e-10 | 1.17761487050e-9 | 7.04 |
+| original z20 source | 128 | 5.48788129474e-11 | 6.73281121939e-10 | 12.27 |
+| two-age attenuated manufactured | 96 | 3.50586027731e-11 | 7.32052270802e-11 | 2.09 |
+| two-age attenuated manufactured | 128 | 3.26510158401e-11 | 4.10841976753e-11 | 1.26 |
+
+At initial source adaptive N128 the HeI relative halfwidth is ~1.92% of true packet one-step event, compared to uniform128 ~23.57%. At the hardened two-age N96 it is ~4.28% vs uniform96 ~8.94%. This comparison assumes the additional **true child moments from the packet oracle**. It is NOT an error certificate for a real SOURCE07 stock whose only evolved state is original N,U. Other HI/heat components have separate widths and goals in machine-readable results; HeI-focused selection does not necessarily optimize all six components.
+
+`HEI_FOCUS` scales `(.1,1e-10,.1,.1,.1,.1)` are explicitly chosen to drive the already-observed HeI issue. At original source N96 the selected HeI width target is not met -> **HOLD**. At N128 `5.49e-11 <1e-10` and the requested local target passes. The six-scale selection is a priority not a replacement of any canonical AXBI gate.
+
+## Numerical algorithms, performance and reproducibility
+
+1. True packet dyadic Fraction prefix reduces `N,U` query from O(P) scan to O(log P) without changes in exact values. Benchmark original binary64 5496 packet two-age stock, 150 interval requests, three repeats: native Python full scan median0.6833s vs prefix0.001725s (**396.1x** for packet-query kernel, not overall transport speed).
+2. Adaptive heap refines only selected source-support intervals; `make_template` calculations are expensive and dominate. N128 original-source result took about3s starting N64; uniform128 roughly1.2s for whole shape-free bound, but the adaptive HeI width was12.27x narrower at matched state count. No identical-error speedup claim.
+3. Four independent manufactured ray/source-gas tasks with `cached_template.cache_clear()` per job prevent **fork inherited warm cache** from inflating parallel benchmark: cold 1 worker8.229s, 2workers3.863s, 4workers2.182s, bit-identical returned values in all worker choices. This is process scheduling, NOT native subagent delegation, and does not imply Rust solver parallel efficiency.
+4. Tests cover exact mass/energy identity, atom-threshold split, deliberate parent moment ambiguity, invalid corpus & source/clock, actual initial/hardened packet response inclusion for all HI/HeI/HeII and direct heats, nonincreasing global bounds, source and hardening monotone, and precision PASS/HOLD. Full 47 regressions include prior PR70 source envelope tests unchanged.
+
+## Actual other-repo current result
+
+As of 2026-10-15 ~12:56 KST authorized `rei_bianchi` HEAD `a950711f9cf57eea065d2ce30b15aba54b60bf53`: SOURCE07 C7 has a genuine z20/z4 two-emission Bianchi test, where pooled q N/U HI error -0.441% at nE256 despite retaining age-union support, and two **true** age lanes remove nearly all of it. C8 A/B now require actual bounded memory over continuous emission and opacity error budgets. Its signed AX08 remains IN_PROGRESS; AX11/12 PENDING. Existing source and source-order Jacobian are owned by this repo, not by the local adaptive supplier. The present mixed-age manufacture is a distinct, deliberately labelled test, NOT replacement of owner C7 history.
+
+`BASS_HE` PR62 uses warm P01/HM12/FT03 6-cell bounds and does not contribute gas/opacity constants; `WU088_HH` PR77 cusp-shell electron scattering bound has no physical Verner source compatibility. No foreign numerical error estimate imported into this model.
+
+## Scientific status and next C stage
+
+- **Adopt for separate source/packet-refinement experiments:** true-child-moment adaptive q-bin `CR_ADAPTIVE_Q_GRID_FROM_ENVELOPE_WIDTH` pilot, conditional shape-free bounds, performance and negative controls completed.
+- **Do not admit direct owner q-history from parent N/U:** no true child moment mechanism in current C7/C8 canonical grid; creating a finer grid by subdividing those two stored numbers without extra subcell information is not rigorous.
+- **Owner C8 consumption:** source injection can obtain child moments from the real source quadrature; hardened current stock needs new finite age/subband state or verified packet oracle. Compare at same R*J, proper source/IC and per-ray direction, no cross-age/direction scalar mixing.
+- **Separate later tasks:** apply true owner SOURCE07 C8 source/age state to the adaptive selector, true nonlinear gas/temperature trajectory, full EoR history, the separate bass_cr Landau kinetic fine constitutive adjoint. Original CR/RCT/HH OFF and original20 kBT/FR source scenarios preserved.
+
+## Primary background
+
+- G. Winkler, *Extreme Points of Moment Sets* (Math. Oper. Res. 1988), DOI 10.1287/moor.13.4.581: moment-constrained extrema and finitely supported measures; supports the parent PR70 two-atom convex envelope method.
+- Mirocha et al. (2012), arXiv:1204.1944: reaction-weighted photoionization/heating source discretization as independent fidelity target.
+- Baumschlager, Shen & Wadsley, (2024), arXiv:2310.16902: positive within-band spectral reconstruction and ionization-edge jump representations.
+
+**No claim of new mathematical novelty for generalized moment extrema, global time evolution, or full astrophysical product.**

+"""Matched source corpus, adaptive-vs-uniform q support; not cosmological simulation."""
+import argparse,json,time
+import numpy as np
+from adaptive_q import PositivePacketOracle,AdaptiveQGrid
+from source_subcells import source_quadrature, reaction_fraction, reference_edges, PHYSICAL_BINDING
+
+EMITTED=4.298036114764196e-8
+REAL_RHO=(0.0017575700008892194,.0001429214010766023,0.)
+REAL_DT=1e10
+BUDGET=(1e-8,1e-9,1e-12,1e-7,1e-8,1e-11)
+HEI_FOCUS_BUDGET=(.1,1e-10,.1,.1,.1,.1)
+
+def current_packets(hardened=False):
+    if not hardened:
+        s=source_quadrature(1024,order=8)
+        return PositivePacketOracle(s.energy_nodes_ref_eV,s.photon_weight_per_initial_H*EMITTED,'MD14_BB50K_NATIVE48','ray-mu-0.25',0.),1.,REAL_RHO,REAL_DT
+    old=source_quadrature(512,ratio_R=.98,order=8)
+    new=source_quadrature(512,ratio_R=1.,order=8)
+    gas_pre=(.001,.00012,.00001)
+    frac,survivors=reaction_fraction(old.energy_nodes_ref_eV*.99,gas_pre,2e9)
+    energies=np.r_[old.energy_nodes_ref_eV,new.energy_nodes_ref_eV]
+    weights=np.r_[old.photon_weight_per_initial_H*.5*EMITTED*survivors,new.photon_weight_per_initial_H*.5*EMITTED]
+    return PositivePacketOracle(energies,weights,'MD14_TWO_BIRTH_PACKET_ORACLE','ray-mu-0.25',0.),.97,(.0008,.00009,.000005),4e9
+
+
+def packet_truth(oracle,ratio,gas,dt):
+    energies=np.asarray([float(e)*ratio for e in oracle.energies])
+    counts=np.asarray([float(n) for n in oracle.counts])
+    events,_=reaction_fraction(energies,gas,dt)
+    val=events@counts
+    heat=(events*(energies[None,:]-np.asarray(PHYSICAL_BINDING)[:,None]))@counts
+    return np.r_[val,heat]
+
+
+def run_case(oracle,ratio,gas,dt,base=64,targets=(80,96,128),node_order=4,budgets=BUDGET):
+    edges=np.geomspace(13.6,433.,base+1)
+    model=AdaptiveQGrid(oracle,edges,ratio,gas,dt,budgets,nodes_per_branch=node_order)
+    truth=packet_truth(oracle,ratio,gas,dt)
+    results=[]
+    start=time.perf_counter()
+    for target in targets:
+        t0=time.perf_counter()
+        out=model.run(target)

+"""Bounded 1/2/4 process source-local independent ray benchmark.
+
+Runs different physical gas/time rays in separate processes. Native subagents
+are NOT involved; only multiprocessing for verified numerical kernels.
+"""
+import argparse,json,time
+from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor
+from adaptive_q import AdaptiveQGrid
+from moment_envelopes import cached_template
+from adaptive_benchmark import current_packets,HEI_FOCUS_BUDGET
+import numpy as np
+
+
+def _solve(idx:int):
+    # All independently scheduled jobs start from the SAME COLD template state.
+    # Avoid a misleading speedup from fork-inherited warmed parent LRU entries.
+    cached_template.cache_clear()
+    oracle,ratio,gas,dt=current_packets(bool(idx%2))
+    # Actual q rays are externally different physical characteristics; these
+    # settings are bounded manufactured controls, NOT SOURCE07 gas chronology.
+    rho=(gas[0]*(1.+idx*.025),gas[1]*(1.+idx*.02),gas[2]*(1.+idx*.01))
+    a=AdaptiveQGrid(oracle,np.geomspace(13.6,433.,65),ratio,rho,dt,HEI_FOCUS_BUDGET,4)
+    out=a.run(96)
+    return (idx,out['widths'],out['mass'],out['reference_energy_eV'])
+
+
+def measure(workers:int,ray_count:int=4):
+    if workers not in (1,2,4) or ray_count not in (2,4,8):
+        raise ValueError('workload/cpu bound violated')
+    t=time.perf_counter()
+    if workers==1:
+        x=[_solve(i) for i in range(ray_count)]
+    else:
+        with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool:
+            x=list(pool.map(_solve,range(ray_count)))
+    return {'workers':workers,'rays':ray_count,'seconds':time.perf_counter()-t,'outputs':x}
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--rays',type=int,default=4);args=ap.parse_args()
+    data=[measure(w,args.rays) for w in (1,2,4)]
+    baseline=data[0]['outputs']
+    assert all(x['outputs']==baseline for x in data)
+    print(json.dumps({'model':'FOUR_INDEPENDENT_FROZEN_RAYS_NOT_EOR','results':data},indent=2))

+"""Oracle-backed adaptive q-energy support with shape-free reaction bounds.
+
+Frozen current gas/proper-time and one ray only. Does NOT infer child mass/mean
+from parent N,U, nor recover missing spectral information. True child dyadic
+packet moments are supplied by a separate positive source-oracle/packet ledger.
+Geometry R, angular Jacobian, emission clock and source identity remain external.
+
+Certified scope: conditional on the original moment_envelopes.ShapeFreeTemplate
+outer evaluation at true child moments/support; all internal partition sums use
+exact rational arithmetic on stored binary64 input. Independent child constraints
+imply nested analytic feasible moment sets. We intersect global outer bounds
+with previous bounds to preserve nesting in binary64 output.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+from bisect import bisect_left
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from fractions import Fraction
+from heapq import heappop, heappush
+from math import isfinite, log, nextafter, inf, sqrt
+from typing import Sequence
+import numpy as np
+from moment_envelopes import cached_template

+FIT_CUTOFFS=(13.6,24.59,54.42)
+
+
+def F(x):
+    if isinstance(x,Fraction):return x
+    v=float(x)
+    if not isfinite(v):raise ValueError('finite dyadic expected')
+    return Fraction.from_float(v)
+
+
+class PositivePacketOracle:
+    """Sorted packet distribution treated as the exact stored-dyadic measure.
+
+    This oracle represents an *additional* piece of input evidence, not a
+    property of the parent q-grid N,U alone.
+    """
+    def __init__(self,reference_energies,photons_per_h,source_id:str,ray_id:str,proper_epoch_s:float):
+        es=np.asarray(reference_energies,float);ww=np.asarray(photons_per_h,float)
+        if es.ndim!=1 or ww.ndim!=1 or len(es)!=len(ww) or not len(es):
+            raise ValueError('positive packet measure required')
+        if not np.all(np.isfinite(es)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(ww)) or np.any(es<=0) or np.any(ww<0):
+            raise ValueError('invalid positive photon packet')
+        if not source_id or not ray_id or not isfinite(proper_epoch_s):
+            raise ValueError('physical packet provenance required')
+        order=np.argsort(es,kind='stable')
+        self.energies=[F(x) for x in es[order]]
+        self.counts=[F(x) for x in ww[order]]
+        self.source_id=str(source_id);self.ray_id=str(ray_id);self.proper_epoch_s=float(proper_epoch_s)
+        self.prefix_n=[Fraction(0)];self.prefix_u=[Fraction(0)]
+        for e,n in zip(self.energies,self.counts):
+            self.prefix_n.append(self.prefix_n[-1]+n)
+            self.prefix_u.append(self.prefix_u[-1]+e*n)
+        self.total_n=self.prefix_n[-1];self.total_u=self.prefix_u[-1]
+
+    def moments(self,a,b,closed_right:bool=False):
+        """Half-open q-cell, except last inclusive; exact arithmetic."""
+        lo,hi=F(a),F(b)
+        if not lo<hi:raise ValueError('ordered q support required')
+        left=bisect_left(self.energies,lo)
+        right=bisect_left(self.energies,hi)
+        if closed_right:
+            while right<len(self.energies) and self.energies[right]==hi:right+=1
+        return self.prefix_n[right]-self.prefix_n[left],self.prefix_u[right]-self.prefix_u[left]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Cell:
+    ident:int
+    a:float
+    b:float
+    n:Fraction
+    u:Fraction
+    bounds:tuple[tuple[Fraction,Fraction],...]
+    score:float
+
+
+class AdaptiveQGrid:
+    """Greedy heap refinement using actual child packet moments.
+
+    Rejects unsupported parent-only N,U splits. Supports single ray and one
+    current proper clock. Interval ledgers are exact dyadic Fraction sums.
+    """
+    def __init__(self,oracle:PositivePacketOracle,ref_edges:Sequence[float],ratio_R:float,
+                 neutrals_cm3:Sequence[float],dt_s:float,budgets:Sequence[float],
+                 nodes_per_branch:int=4):
+        if not isinstance(oracle,PositivePacketOracle):
+            raise ValueError('adaptive child moments need positive packet oracle')
+        ed=np.asarray(ref_edges,float)
+        if len(ed)<2 or not np.all(np.isfinite(ed)) or np.any(np.diff(ed)<=0):
+            raise ValueError('fixed ordered q-bin edges required')
+        if not isfinite(ratio_R) or ratio_R<=0 or not (0<ed[0]<ed[-1]<=50000):
+            raise ValueError('physical reference energy/R invalid')
+        self.edges=[float(x) for x in ed]
+        if oracle.energies[0]<F(ed[0]) or oracle.energies[-1]>F(ed[-1]):
+            raise ValueError('packet measure exceeds declared full q support')
+        self.ratio=float(ratio_R)
+        self.neutrals=tuple(float(n) for n in neutrals_cm3)
+        self.dt=float(dt_s)
+        self.budgets=tuple(float(b) for b in budgets)
+        if len(self.budgets)!=6 or any(not isfinite(b) or b<=0 for b in self.budgets):
+            raise ValueError('all six physical observable budgets must be positive')
+        if len(self.neutrals)!=3 or any(not isfinite(x) or x<0 for x in self.neutrals) or not isfinite(self.dt) or self.dt<0:
+            raise ValueError('invalid current gas / proper clock')
+        self.oracle=oracle;self.nodes=nodes_per_branch
+        self.cells={};self.heap=[];self.serial=0;self.split_count=0;self.trace=[]
+        self.raw_low=[Fraction(0)]*6;self.raw_high=[Fraction(0)]*6
+        for a,b in zip(self.edges[:-1],self.edges[1:]):
+            c=self._make(float(a),float(b),closed_right=(b==self.edges[-1]))
+            self._insert(c)
+        self.global_lo=self.raw_low.copy();self.global_hi=self.raw_high.copy()
+        self.initial_cell_count=len(self.cells)
+        self._check_moment_conservation()
+
+    def _make(self,a,b,closed_right=False):
+        n,u=self.oracle.moments(a,b,closed_right)
+        if n==0:
+            bounds=tuple((Fraction(0),Fraction(0)) for _ in range(6))
+            score=0.
+        else:
+            mn=u/n
+            if mn<F(a) or mn>F(b):raise ArithmeticError('true positive child mean outside q cell')
+            # Widen physical q-cell endpoints to encompass exact stored dyadics.
+            aa=F(a)*F(self.ratio);bb=F(b)*F(self.ratio)
+            lo=nextafter(float(aa),-inf);hi=nextafter(float(bb),inf)
+            if lo<=0 or hi>50000:raise ValueError('physical support out of the Verner fit')
+            t=cached_template(lo,hi,self.neutrals,self.dt,self.nodes)
+            z=t.evaluate(n,mn*F(self.ratio))
+            bounds=tuple((F(x),F(y)) for x,y in z['event']+z['heat'])
+            if any(h<l for l,h in bounds):raise ArithmeticError('invalid certified interval')
+            score=max(float((h-l)/F(budget)) for (l,h),budget in zip(bounds,self.budgets))
+        self.serial+=1
+        return Cell(self.serial,a,b,n,u,bounds,score)
+
+    def _insert(self,c):
+        self.cells[c.ident]=c
+        for j,(a,b) in enumerate(c.bounds):
+            self.raw_low[j]+=a;self.raw_high[j]+=b
+        heappush(self.heap,(-c.score,c.a,c.ident))
+
+    def _delete(self,c):
+        del self.cells[c.ident]
+        for j,(a,b) in enumerate(c.bounds):
+            self.raw_low[j]-=a;self.raw_high[j]-=b
+
+    def _split_location(self,c):
+        # Whenever an active atomic fit boundary lies inside the *physical*
+        # range, put an explicit q-edge there, before generic logarithmic split.
+        a=F(c.a);b=F(c.b);r=F(self.ratio)
+        active=[float(F(fit)/r) for fit in FIT_CUTOFFS if a<F(fit)/r<b]
+        if active:
+            candidate=min(active,key=lambda v:abs(log(v)-.5*(log(c.a)+log(c.b))))
+        else:
+            candidate=sqrt(c.a*c.b)
+        if not c.a<candidate<c.b:return None
+        return candidate
+
+    def _check_moment_conservation(self):
+        count=sum((c.n for c in self.cells.values()),Fraction(0))
+        energy=sum((c.u for c in self.cells.values()),Fraction(0))
+        if count!=self.oracle.total_n or energy!=self.oracle.total_u:
+            raise ArithmeticError('not the original exact photon count / first energy moment')
+
+    def _commit_intersection(self):
+        # Both previous and new intervals enclose the SAME exact observables.
+        for j in range(6):
+            a=max(self.global_lo[j],self.raw_low[j]);b=min(self.global_hi[j],self.raw_high[j])
+            if b<a:raise ArithmeticError('inconsistent old/new outer intervals')
+            self.global_lo[j]=a;self.global_hi[j]=b
+
+    def run(self,max_cells:int,stop_on_precision:bool=False):
+        if not isinstance(max_cells,int) or max_cells>8192:
+            raise ValueError('bounded integer adaptive grid required')
+        if max_cells<len(self.cells):raise ValueError('cannot coarsen from moment-only input')
+        while len(self.cells)<max_cells and self.heap:
+            if stop_on_precision and self.precision_goal_met():break
+            _,_,ident=heappop(self.heap)
+            c=self.cells.get(ident)
+            if c is None:continue
+            if c.n==0:break  # all positive cells have >= score
+            loc=self._split_location(c)
+            if loc is None:continue
+            left=self._make(c.a,loc)
+            right=self._make(loc,c.b,closed_right=(c.b==self.edges[-1]))
+            if left.n+right.n!=c.n or left.u+right.u!=c.u:
+                raise ArithmeticError('true child moments are not a partition of parent')
+            # Prevalidate complete global intersection, transactional state.
+            trial_lower=[self.raw_low[j]-c.bounds[j][0]+left.bounds[j][0]+right.bounds[j][0] for j in range(6)]
+            trial_upper=[self.raw_high[j]-c.bounds[j][1]+left.bounds[j][1]+right.bounds[j][1] for j in range(6)]
+            if any(max(self.global_lo[j],trial_lower[j])>min(self.global_hi[j],trial_upper[j]) for j in range(6)):
+                raise ArithmeticError('inconsistent split enclosures: unchanged state')
+            self._delete(c);self._insert(left);self._insert(right)
+            self._commit_intersection();self.split_count+=1
+            self.trace.append({'split':self.split_count,'a':c.a,'b':c.b,'at':loc,'score':c.score,
+                               'new_cells':len(self.cells)})
+        self._check_moment_conservation()
+        return self.summary()
+
+    def precision_goal_met(self):
+        return all(self.global_hi[j]-self.global_lo[j]<=F(t) for j,t in enumerate(self.budgets))
+
+    def summary(self):
+        outer=[]
+        for a,b in zip(self.global_lo,self.global_hi):
+            outer.append((0. if a<=0 else nextafter(float(a),-inf),
+                          0. if b<=0 else nextafter(float(b),inf)))

+                'widths':[hi-lo for lo,hi in outer],
+                'mass':float(self.oracle.total_n), 'reference_energy_eV':float(self.oracle.total_u),

+                'exact_dyadic_partition':True,
+                'precision_target_met':self.precision_goal_met(),
+                'precision_gate':'PASS_SCOPED' if self.precision_goal_met() else 'HOLD_PRECISION_TARGET',
+                'requested_width_scales':self.budgets}
+
+    def sorted_edges(self):
+        return sorted({v for c in self.cells.values() for v in (c.a,c.b)})
